summary: Frontend-only RETEST of iteration_2 fixes on https://metin2-promote.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: (1) AddServer step navigation — 'Devam' on tab 1 and tab 2 no longer submits/publishes (no 'Serveriniz eklendi!' toast, no redirect; landed on tab 3 with badge picker visible). CRITICAL bug is FIXED. (2) Featured badge picker toggle works (★/☆ + 'on' class); selecting a 5th badge fired the toast 'Kartta en fazla 4 rozet gösterilir.' EXACTLY ONCE (toast count = 1) and the 5th badge was NOT selected — duplicate-toast LOW bug is FIXED. (3) Setting sys-select-loncaAjan to '1' (Yok) removed featured-pick-loncaAjan from the picker and deselected it. (4) Published with exactly 3 badges -> redirect to /server/312; on Home, server-sys-badges-312 shows ONLY the 3 selected features (Boss Takip Sistemi, Güvenli PC Girişi, Ticaret Camı) plus a '+4' overflow chip. (5) Seed server Elora2 fallback (server-sys-badges-311) shows 4 default enabled badges + '+3' overflow. No backend testing performed (frontend-only, localStorage mock).

issues: When a user explicitly picks fewer than 4 featured badges (e.g. 3), the card still shows a '+4' overflow chip computed from ALL enabled systems (extraSys = enabledSys.length - shownSys.length). Cosmetically inconsistent with the 'these are my chosen highlights' intent — consider computing overflow as enabledSys.length - featuredSys.length only in fallback mode, or label it as remaining systems.

action_items: Optional/low: reconsider overflow ('+N') counting on ServerRow when featuredSystem is explicitly set.
critical_code_review_comments: AddServer.jsx still wraps steps in a <form onSubmit={submit}> while both nav buttons are type='button'. Works now, but pressing Enter in a text input on tab 1 can still trigger form submit/publish from step 1 — consider guarding submit by requiring tab === 'sistem' or removing the onSubmit handler.
React hydration warning in console: <span> rendered as child of <option> (AddServer.jsx line 102 option list) — caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapper; harmless in preview but noisy.
seed_data_creation: Created one localStorage server via UI: name 'TestNav', title 'Test 1-99', id 312, featuredSystem [bossTakip, guvenliPc, ticaretCami], loncaAjan disabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_2 bugs (Devam auto-submit, duplicate max-4 toast) are confirmed fixed. Test server id 312 exists in localStorage from this run; clear localStorage if it interferes. Remaining untested areas: server detail page, voting/like persistence, category filtering, search, blog, popup ad, settings/theme, mobile responsiveness.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — previous root cause (React reusing the same button DOM node while type mutated button->submit) is resolved by distinct key props + type='button' with onClick={submit}; toast duplication resolved by moving toast.error out of the setForm updater (no longer re-run under StrictMode double-invoke).
